title: Resolution of the Skolem Problem for $k$-Generalized Lucas Sequences
summary: This paper provides a complete solution to Skolem's problem for the $k$-generalized Lucas sequence $(L_n^{(k)})_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ with a primary focus on its behavior at negative indices. We characterize the zero-distribution of this sequence by identifying and bounding all indices $n < 0$ such that $L_n^{(k)} = 0$. Our central result establishes that the zero-multiplicity $δ_k$ of the sequence is $(k-1)(k-2)/2$ for all $k.$
